subject: Re: Zeniton pilot — IT/CISO alignment and timebox
messages:
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@zeniton.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: sara@zeniton.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot request: quick pilot + IT/CISO join?

Hi Connor — we just kicked the tires on the self-serve and would like to run a short pilot/demo for stakeholders next week. We want AE + SE in the room and for IT and our CISO to be present for 15–20 mins to validate security/hosting assumptions.

Two candidate windows that work for our group (PST):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–10:45 AM PST
- Wed Mar 3, 2:00–2:45 PM PST

If neither works we can move to the following week. Please loop in whoever from your side needs to join. I can have Sara (cc'ed) send an invitation once we lock a time.

Goal: 30–45 min pilot + 15 min for IT/CISO Q&A.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Keller
Head of Product, Zeniton Health

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, tom.keller@zeniton.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:10:24 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request: quick pilot + IT/CISO join? — warm handoff

Connor — quick warm handoff from the inbound signup.
Context:
- Zeniton is a small digital health shop (pilot) — evaluating latency and private deployment story.
- They requested AE+SE + IT/CISO presence.
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4729 (details + usage notes).

Suggested slots (same as customer):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–10:45 AM PST (preferred by customer)
- Wed Mar 3, 2:00–2:45 PM PST (fallback)

Notes: customer is security-sensitive; likely to ask about SOC 2, data retention and VPC options. They're in PST for product; Core IT in EST.

Can you confirm availability and whether SE can take the deeper technical Q&A? Attaching the intake notes.

— Jasmine
SDR, Redwood

Attachments: inbound-intake-note.txt (stub)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: tom.keller@zeniton.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot request: quick pilot + IT/CISO join?

Tom — thanks for the note and for trying self-serve. Happy to run the pilot with AE+SE+IT/CISO.

We can do Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 AM PST as proposed. If that ends up not working for any of your stakeholders, Wed Mar 3 1:00–1:45 PM PST is an alternate I can offer (I blocked time).

Quick timezone conversions for visibility:
- Mar 2, 10:00 AM PST = 1:00 PM EST = 6:00 PM GMT
- Mar 3, 1:00 PM PST = 4:00 PM EST = 9:00 PM GMT

Agenda (proposed, 45 min):
1) 10 min — intro + goals (AE)
2) 20 min — live pilot / product walkthrough (AE + SE)
3) 15 min — IT/CISO Q&A (SE + me)

Soojin (SE) will lead technical answers and follow-ups. Priya / Alex — can you confirm which slot works for you and whether you prefer a separate technical deep-dive after the pilot?

I attached a calendar stub so Sara can drop a final invite once we confirm (calendar-invite-march02.ics). Also, if you need our SOC 2 summary ahead of time let me know and I'll pull that.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Attachments: calendar-invite-march02.ics (stub)

From: priya.singh@zeniton.com
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: tom.keller@zeniton.com, alex.ruiz@zeniton.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot request: quick pilot + IT/CISO join?

Connor / Soojin — thanks. We can do Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 AM PST (1:00 PM EST). A few quick constraints from our side: 
- Please share a brief SOC 2 summary and a data flow diagram prior to the meeting.
- We'll join for the 45-minute session but will likely only attend the last 20 minutes for security questions.
- If possible, include a one-page note on retention defaults and encryption at rest/key management.

I'm attaching our security questionnaire — we'd like Redwood to fill section 3 (data handling) before the call so we can triage answers with our ops team.

Priya Singh
CISO, Zeniton Health

Attachments: zeniton-security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx (their internal questionnaire stub)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, tom.keller@zeniton.com
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot request: quick pilot + IT/CISO join? — SE preflight

Thanks Priya — noted. Connor, I'll own the technical preflight and can draft the one-page note on retention/encryption by EOD Monday.

Small ask from SE side: can we tighten the public demo to 30–35 minutes and reserve ~20–30 minutes for security/infra Q&A (so we don't overrun and can dive deep if needed). If Priya prefers a separate deep-dive, I'm happy to schedule a follow-up 30-min technical session.

Attached is a short preflight checklist I use to prepare for these calls. I'll also populate the data-flow diagram and send the SOC 2 summary if your infra/compliance team needs it.

— Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.md (stub)

From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@zeniton.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: sara@zeniton.com, priya.singh@zeniton.com, alex.ruiz@zeniton.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot request: quick pilot + IT/CISO join? — confirmed

Connor / team — that works for us. Please lock Tue Mar 2, 10:00–10:45 AM PST. Sara (cc) will send the final calendar invite to all participants and include dial-in. 

We'll plan to have Priya attend the last ~20 minutes; Alex will join for the infra Q&A. If you can get the SOC 2 summary and the filled portion of the questionnaire back to us by EOD Monday, that would be ideal.

Looking forward to it.

Tom
Head of Product, Zeniton Health
